gates.name: Inspect tarball
gates.command: tar -tzf src/engine/*.tgz; assert no src/, no tsconfig*.json, no .test.* artifacts, package/dist/ present

gates.name: Consumer smoke
gates.command: rm -rf consumer-smoke/{node_modules,package-lock.json,dist}; cd consumer-smoke; npm run install:engine; npm run build; npm run smoke

gates.name: Validate Markdown links, terminology, and generated files
Build documentation
gates.command: ./docs.ps1 -BuildOnly (local stand-in for /template/scripts/docs-build.ps1; needs Docker and an installed docs.ps1)

gates.name: Build and verify landing page
gates.command: npm --prefix src/engine run build; npm --prefix site run check

gates.name: Merge landing page into documentation build
gates.command: npm --prefix site run merge (needs a prior docs build in artifacts/docs)

gates.name: Test the host
gates.command: dotnet test src/host/SubZeroDev.GameEngine.Host.Tests/SubZeroDev.GameEngine.Host.Tests.csproj (needs NUGET_GITHUB_TOKEN for the sibling-repo package feed)

gates.name: Positive route and probe smoke
gates.command: docker build -t subzerodev-gameengine-host:smoke .; docker run -d -p 18080:8080; curl /, /roadmap/, /docs/, /health/live, /health/ready -> 200 and an unknown route -> 404

gates.name: Negative fixture -- corrupted artifact must fail to start
gates.command: docker build -f tools/host-smoke/Dockerfile.negative-fixture --build-arg BASE_IMAGE=subzerodev-gameengine-host:smoke; docker run must exit non-zero
